{{Top|leg|canon=Sensorscope}}
[[File:R2-D2_droid_sensorscope_Dagobah.jpg|250px|thumb|R2-D2's sensorscope rising from a Dagobah swamp]]
A '''droid sensorscope''', also simply known as a '''periscope'''<ref name="TESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref>, was a device standard on [[R-series/Legends|R-series astromech droids]], equipped with a full-spectrum [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|transceiver]] with [[Electro photo receptor|electro-photo receptors]], [[Dedicated energy receptor/Legends|dedicated energy receptors]], [[heat detector]], and [[Motion sensor/Legends|motion detectors]]. Data received through the sensorscope was routed to the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] [[Intellex IV/Legends|Intellex IV]] internal [[Computer/Legends|computer]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Droid Sensorscope}}</ref> It was an extendible auxiliary visual imaging system<ref name="Complete Visual">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> that raised up from a panel in the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] dome, allowing it to see what shorter droids usually couldn't.<ref name="Blueprints">''[[Star Wars Blueprints: The Ultimate Collection]]''</ref>

[[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] used his sensorscope at various times including to navigate through a [[Dragonsnake Bog/Legends|swamp]] on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] after falling into the water shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="TESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> He later used it to see after falling into the sands of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to escape [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Khetanna/Legends|sail barge]] during the [[Rescue of Han Solo/Legends|Rescue of Han Solo]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
R2-D2's sensor first seen rising out of the swamp in {{Film|V}} was referred to as a "periscope" in some early material surrounding the movie.<ref name="TESB novel" /><ref name="TESB Storybook">''[[The Empire Strikes Back Storybook]]''</ref> The device was named a "sensorscope" with the release of [[Kenner Products|Kenner's]] second R2-D2 action figure in [[1981]].<ref name="Kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (toy line)|pack=Artoo-Detoo (R2-D2) with Sensorscope|link=VINtR2D2scope.asp}}</ref> The figure's packaging featured an image of the droid using a [[R2 sensor array|different scanner]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] but the toy's scanner more resembled the one seen on Dagobah.<ref name="TAFA">''[[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive]]''</ref> The specific scanner was later identified as a "droid sensorscope" by the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] and ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Droid Sensorscope}}</ref><ref name="Behind">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref>
